thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired — PD#43129 — p99 latency SLO burning in eu-west (service: inference-api)

oncall-alex: acked. I'm on it. grabbing dashboards now.

eng-sre-maya: i'm up, assigning to alex. any obvious region-level failures?

oncall-alex: dashboards show p99 from ~420ms -> ~1.8s in the last 6m, error budget 12% -> 55% used. traffic spike on rerank/long-context jobs. tail latency concentrated on sidecar queues.

runtime-li: looks like the new quantized variant rollout spiked CPU on sidecars; evictions on a subset of pods. logs:
```
W memory eviction: pod inference-sidecar-5f7c OOM_kill
WARN kvcache: miss rate 12% -> 48%
```

oncall-alex: can we temporarily stop the rollout and roll back the quantized variant? that's fastest.

eng-sre-maya: doing canary rollback now.

eng-sre-maya: command run:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/model-serving-quant --to-revision=42
kubectl -n inference scale deployment sidecar --replicas=50
```

incident-bot: action logged: rollout undo initiated by eng-sre-maya

support-jordan: flagged potential customer impact: a few enterprise tenants on eu-west reported timeouts in last 5m — CS alerted.

runtime-li: also increasing KV cache mem for hot shards. patch:
```
kubectl patch configmap kv-config -p '{"data":{"max_shard_mem":"6g"}}'
```

oncall-alex: warming caches and scale confirmed. sidecar replicas at 50. monitoring...

pagerduty-bot: PD#43129 acknowledged by oncall-alex

eng-sre-maya: roll back completed, no more OOMs seen in last 30s. p99 dropping to ~650ms and falling.

oncall-alex: keeping the bridge open for 20m. If p99 < 500ms for 10m, we'll close.

support-jordan: updating impacted customers: short note drafted, will send on approval.

runtime-li: quick note for postmortem: check rollout gating for quant variant, add resource headroom checks to canary job.

oncall-alex: agreed. tagging follow-ups. good job team :thumbsup:

incident-bot: incident closed by oncall-alex (after sustained recovery).
